body: Thanks for all the hard work y'all've put into the engine!
I can't reproduce this on 4.5.dev 7b9c5122f (Linux). I don't get any import errors or crashes using LibreOffice Calc 24.8.6.2.

Interesting that using `FileAccess.open` and `FileAccess.get_size` in GDScript works without issues. The "regression" started between 4.4 dev1 and 4.4 dev 2 by pr #93064 but seems that was somehow broken before as in 4.4 dev 1 throws an error saying the file didn't exist: `editor/filesystem_dock.cpp:2725 - Condition "!FileAccess::exists(p_path)" is true. Returning: nullptr`. The relevant difference was this: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/93064/files#diff-d1a420b01f63a620201ea4099997331bc4320c30b0b5371e1a16801b2a32965aL61-L67
Before the engine used `FileAccess::open` to check if file exists (and that fails to open the csv file in use), `FileAccess::exists` wrongly fails and makes the engine return early in `FileSystemDock::create_tooltip_for_path` with the mentioned error. The solution would be either makes `FileAccess::open` works as the file can be used normally by `FileAccess.open` in GDScript or handle the null reference in `editor\plugins\editor_resource_tooltip_plugins.cpp:75`.
